description: Jurisdiction risk for a country (ISO code or name): FATF call-for-action and increased-monitoring lists, EU high-risk third countries, FinCEN Section 311 jurisdictions, OFAC comprehensive sanctions programmes, and how many entries with an address in that country sit on the US export-control and non-SDN lists (BIS Entity, Denied Persons, Unverified and Military End User lists, State nonproliferation and ITAR debarred, OFAC SSI / FSE / CMIC). Returns high / elevated / standard with reasons, the lists and references. Use for country-risk scoring, onboarding, payment corridors and trade compliance.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE, VN) or English name (Vietnam)

name: screen_country
title: Country / jurisdiction risk
